heading.en: How many kinds of life share our planet?

hook.en: India alone grows more than 50,000 genetically different strains of rice. Multiply that variety across every species and every habitat and you begin to see what biodiversity means.
hook.kn: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲೇ 50,000ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಳೀಯವಾಗಿ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಭತ್ತದ ತಳಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಈ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ಆವಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಜೀವವೈವಿಧ್ಯದ ಅರ್ಥ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe genetic, species and ecological diversity
Recall global and Indian species numbers
Explain why India is a mega-diversity country

narration.en: India alone grows more than 50,000 genetically different strains of rice. Multiply that variety across every species and every habitat and you begin to see what biodiversity means.
narration.kn: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲೇ 50,000ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಳೀಯವಾಗಿ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಭತ್ತದ ತಳಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಈ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ಆವಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಜೀವವೈವಿಧ್ಯದ ಅರ್ಥ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Biodiversity is the term popularised by the sociobiologist Edward Wilson to describe the combined diversity at all levels of biological organisation. (i) Genetic diversity: a single species may show high diversity at the genetic level over its distributional range. The medicinal plant Rauwolfia vomitoria growing in different Himalayan ranges shows genetic variation in the potency and concentration of the active chemical reserpine it produces. India has more than 50,000 genetically different strains of rice and 1,000 varieties of mango. (ii) Species diversity: diversity at the species level; the Western Ghats have a greater amphibian species diversity than the Eastern Ghats. (iii) Ecological diversity: at the ecosystem level, India, with its deserts, rain forests, mangroves, coral reefs, wetlands, estuaries and alpine meadows, has a greater ecosystem diversity than a Scandinavian country like Norway.

points.en: Genetic: Rauwolfia vomitoria (reserpine); >50,000 rice strains, 1,000 mango varieties
Species: Western Ghats > Eastern Ghats in amphibians

narration.en: Biodiversity exists at three levels: genetic diversity, like the 50,000 rice strains of India; species diversity, like the amphibians of the Western Ghats; and ecological diversity, like India's range of deserts, rain forests, mangroves and coral reefs.
narration.kn: ಜೀವವೈವಿಧ್ಯ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿದೆ: ಭಾರತದ 50,000 ಭತ್ತದ ತಳಿಗಳಂತೆ ತಳೀಯ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯ; ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳ ಉಭಯಚರಿಗಳಂತೆ ಪ್ರಭೇದ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯ; ಭಾರತದ ಮರುಭೂಮಿ, ಮಳೆಕಾಡು, ಕಾಂಡ್ಲಾ ಕಾಡು, ಹವಳದ ದಿಬ್ಬಗಳಂತೆ ಪರಿಸರೀಯ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯ.

title.en: How many species, on Earth and in India?

body.en: According to the IUCN (2004), the total number of plant and animal species described so far is slightly more than 1.5 million. Robert May places the global species diversity at about 7 million. More than 70 per cent of all recorded species are animals, while plants (including algae, fungi, bryophytes, gymnosperms and angiosperms) make up no more than 22 per cent. Among animals, insects are the most species-rich group, making up more than 70 per cent: out of every 10 animals on this planet, 7 are insects. The number of fungal species in the world is more than the combined total of the species of fishes, amphibians, reptiles and mammals. Although India has only 2.4 per cent of the world's land area, its share of global species diversity is an impressive 8.1 per cent, which makes it one of the 12 mega-diversity countries. Nearly 45,000 species of plants and twice as many animals have been recorded from India. Applying May's estimate, more than 1,00,000 plant species and over 3,00,000 animal species are yet to be discovered and described in India.

points.en: Described species: slightly more than 1.5 million (IUCN 2004)
India: 2.4% of land area, 8.1% of species; one of 12 mega-diversity countries
India: ~45,000 plant species, twice as many animals

narration.en: About 1.5 million species have been described, but Robert May estimates around 7 million exist. Most recorded species are animals, mostly insects. India has only 2.4 per cent of the world's land but 8.1 per cent of its species: one of the 12 mega-diversity countries.
narration.kn: ಸುಮಾರು 15 ಲಕ್ಷ ಪ್ರಭೇದಗಳನ್ನು ವರ್ಣಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಸುಮಾರು 70 ಲಕ್ಷ ಇರಬಹುದೆಂದು ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಮೇ ಅಂದಾಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದಾಖಲಾದವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನವು ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳು, ಅದರಲ್ಲೂ ಕೀಟಗಳು. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಭೂಭಾಗದ 2.4% ಮಾತ್ರ ಇದ್ದರೂ 8.1% ಪ್ರಭೇದಗಳಿವೆ: ಇದು 12 ಮಹಾವೈವಿಧ್ಯ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು.

problem.en: India has 2.4% of the world's land area but 8.1% of its species. How many times more species-rich is India than its share of land would suggest?

steps.en: If species were spread evenly by area, India's share would equal its land share, 2.4%.

answer.en: About 3.4 times its "fair share" by area.

body.en: Out of every 10 animals on Earth, 7 are insects. And more than 70% of recorded species are animals.
